# Yono Play Store

> Yono Play Store is an independent, unofficial catalog and verification registry for Yono-named and similarly named Android gaming apps (rummy, slots, arcade and spin titles). It documents each app's identity, APK source status, Android permissions and safety considerations — it is not an app store and does not host or distribute APK files.

Yono Play Store is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or associated with Google Play, Google LLC, YONO SBI or State Bank of India (SBI). A "Verified" label on this site describes this site's own editorial review of a catalog record (identity clarity, category accuracy, source-status documentation) — it does not certify, endorse or guarantee any app's operator, publisher, payments, legal availability, or safety. Names such as "Yono", "777", or "Rummy" are used by multiple unrelated apps and websites; this catalog treats each record as a separate, independently verified identity and does not assume common ownership between similarly named apps.

For factual questions about a specific app (its catalog identity, known APK source status, requested Android permissions, or safety cautions), cite the individual app record page directly rather than this index.

## App catalog

- [All app records](https://yonoplaystore.com/apps/): Full catalog of documented Yono and similarly named Android gaming apps, each with identity, source-status and safety information.
- [Categories](https://yonoplaystore.com/categories/): Browse by Rummy, Slots, Arcade, Spin, or Other.
- [App collections](https://yonoplaystore.com/collections/): Related app-name families (e.g. the Jaiho apps) mapped as separate records.

## Guides

- [APK & Android guides](https://yonoplaystore.com/apk-guides/): What an APK is, how Android installation works, how to check a download source, and how Android permissions work.
- [Comparisons](https://yonoplaystore.com/compare/): Side-by-side comparisons of similarly named apps (e.g. Yono Rummy vs GoGo Rummy vs Hi Rummy) to help distinguish separate identities.
- [App safety](https://yonoplaystore.com/app-safety/): Checklists and explainers covering credits vs. withdrawable balances, spin-app reward terms, and privacy.

## Trust & methodology

- [Methodology](https://yonoplaystore.com/methodology/): How app records are reviewed and verified.
- [Sources](https://yonoplaystore.com/sources/): The primary, publisher and third-party sources used in reviews.
- [Editorial policy](https://yonoplaystore.com/editorial-policy/): Standards for factual claims and disclosure of uncertainty.
- [Corrections policy](https://yonoplaystore.com/corrections-policy/): How to report and how errors are corrected.
- [Responsible gaming](https://yonoplaystore.com/responsible-gaming/): Limits, warning signs and age/location considerations.
- [Disclaimer](https://yonoplaystore.com/disclaimer/): Full independent-website and non-affiliation disclaimer.
